title: Coastal Garden
beforeAlt: The dying lawn and a front yard full of shade and no good use
afterAlt: A coastal garden that features a fire pit area, a small veggie garden, welcomes the light without compromising the privacy
description: This front yard is challanged everyday from the sea winds, salinity, and from a busy road, just 50 meters away from the beach. From a very busy yard with a struggling lawn and lots of objects, a big transformation to a front yard where now the homeowners can do their meditation sitting on the green mound. The garden has now space for a small fire pit with a few seats to welcome friends and family. It reflects light from the ground, as it also resembles the beach sand from the local natural landscape. The reclying timber sleepers feature a rustic and natural pathway into a raised garden bed where herbs and small vegetables grow and flourish throughout the seasons. A small front yard that belongs to nature, calms the mind, and it is self-sustainable.
